native.operation: Preserve original logical rect, pivot, border, PPU, native mesh/index/vertex bytes, render key, texture-rect offsets and UV transform. Decode original ASTC mip blocks with the existing UNORM8 decoder into native RGBA32 Texture2D; preserve original texture flags and sampler parameters. Do not use the converter's cropped single-Sprite importer pivot or re-compress the Windows texture.
